Budanov Says Putin Ignored Ukraine’s Ceasefire Proposal
items.description: Kyrylo Budanov, head of the Office of the President of Ukraine, stated that Russia failed to respond to a proposed ceasefire coinciding with the visit of US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. Budanov said the proposal for a temporary halt to airstrikes and frontline combat was communicated directly to Russian Pres…

items.title: After Pretoria peace deal, old enemies in Ethiopia’s Tigray find new ground
items.description: The 2022 peace deal ended the war but left key disputes unresolved, giving the TPLF room to regroup as tensions return.

items.title: Trump sends envoys to Moscow and Kyiv with 'proposal to end the war'
items.description: 'Two great negotiators,' the US president told reporters when asked about Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff's weekend trip. 'We have an idea for peace.' Volodymyr Zelensky meanwhile proposed a reciprocal ceasefire with Russia 'for the duration needed to conduct these talks.'

items.title: Yemen: Fighting intensifies amid Houthi push in the west
items.description: Houthi forces are trying to secure high ground and solidify their control of the entry to the Red Sea in the southwest. The Iran-backed militia abandoned a shaky truce with the Saudi-backed government-in-exile in July.

items.title: Trump, 'parlo con Putin, non intende attaccare i territori della Nato'
items.description: 'Witkoff e Kushner hanno proposta per la fine guerra'

items.title: Justice Ministry Designates Novaya Gazeta as ‘Foreign Agent’
items.description: Authorities claimed Novaya Gazeta opposed the invasion of Ukraine and spread “false information” about elections.

items.title: 'We expect our sons to be killed,' father of teen shot dead in West Bank tells BBC
items.description: Palestinian teenagers Omar al-Naasan and Khalil Abu Alia were shot dead when Israeli settlers and soldiers entered a village in the occupied West Bank.

items.title: Germany's far-right AfD party is poised for power in a state election
items.description: Germany's AfD's TikTok-fueled rise in Saxony-Anhalt is raising fears the country could see its first far-right governor since World War II.

items.title: How growing Israeli-Turkish tensions led to a strike on a Syrian air base
items.description: Could the growing regional rivalry between Turkey and Israel lead to a military clash? A recent Israeli strike on an air base in northern Syria illustrated the two countries’ conflicting strategic interests, but analysts say neither wants war.

items.title: Outside forces fuel Sudan war, new report finds
items.description: Foreign recruitment and external support networks are fuelling the brutal conflict in Sudan, independent UN human rights investigators said on Thursday in a new report, calling for accountability as fighting continues between the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces (RSF).

items.title: Why Was There A Shoot-Out In Kyiv Between Security and Intelligence Agents?
items.description: An armed clash between Ukraine’s military intelligence and security service left three officers wounded in Kyiv. Both sides gave conflicting accounts, while President Zelenskyy called the incident “absolutely disgraceful.”
